name: cat_dead_key2
desc: The same small black witch cat, badly exhausted but refusing to give up: bent over, one paw clutching its side in pain, leaning its weight on the brush like a cane, knees trembling, grimacing with clenched teeth, one eye squeezed shut, heavy sweat, hat crooked. Serious and painful, not comical, no tongue, no tears. Keep the design, colors and size.
